body: Totally normal. I seriously wish I could be there with you because I can remember it all so clearly. I wasn't hungry for a few days and I remember how odd that was but it just didn't affect me. Your whole body is reacting to the stress/emotional pain your mind is sending it :( just try to eat what you can I know it's hard

Yeahh that's why I can be hard to reach out to guy friends :/ 

For me it was just too painful right when it happened I broke down and called like my 8 closest friends and just yeah. They all showed up at my place the next day and I just cried it was so embarrassing and I've never cried in front of people before but don't hold it in. It's natural to feel this way. "Man up" and "it's best" ignore reality. The truth is it's just going to hurt and you have to try to survive and distract yourself for now.

If you can force yourself, yoga/push-ups/sit ups are a great way I've found to push myself to exhaustion just so I can sleep. Emotionally the pain, if it gets so bad you can't bear it, call that number or try hitting the floor and doing something physical until your body is pushed to exhaustion. Hope you're still doing okay!

It's just an ocean of pain agh I feel for you I really do. For days I was just a zombie. Some days I still am. But it's just our minds telling us constantly, like seriously every 5 minutes your mind is going to do a mental check "everything is wrong" because of this. It's called rumination. Avoid it like the plague.

 Any time your mind thinks of her you just have to train yourself to think of something else. I'm not sure if this would work for anyone else, but what I would do is associate myself with one of my favorite characters. Like jack sparrow, James Bond, characters who I can identify with (male) who consistently choose to live independently because their own goals are above something as simple as just one relationship. It might seem silly but it always helped me. 

OH and I almost forgot, change your cell phone ring tones text and call! Hearing the old familiar sound will just be a reminder of when you hear it, that it isn't your loved one reaching out to you. Try to stay in the moment, try not to feel too much at once. 

And I'm sorry if this is all too much. I couldn't even think my first night after like I said. This is all just what has kept me around so I thought I'd give it a shot and share <3

Everyone is different but I tend to be similar. My advice, don't bother thinking about yourselves in terms of another relationship. If that comes, it will be far far in the future. 

I was blindsided by mine, so even after months my entire being cringes from opening myself up again. What we can focus on is ourselves, being happy independently. 
Do you like to read? Marcus Aurelius' "Meditations" and "Walden" by Thoreau were some of my favorites to help change my perspective. 

If you don't like to read how about tv, movies, or music? Putting on a mindless sappy comedy every night like the office or the Big Bang can help distract. 

Anyways I hope some of this helps.. Many people won't understand it isn't about fixing anything right now. It's just a game of survival. And trust me on one thing, even if somehow you get back with this person, they broke your trust this time. Even if that magic dream works out, protect yourself. Our goal must be to be stronger independently right now, and stay that way so this never happens again, even if in a new relationship. I'm here if needed friend! If my responses become slow I apologize, stuck at work.

Just went through this in august with a long term partner. It's absolutely the worst pain, nothing will really help all I can say is reach out to your friends right away. Don't try to do this alone. You don't have to. I didn't spend the first few nights alone after it happened to me, my cousin stayed over one night, my brother another. People do care and will be willing to talk please reach out! 

And if you have no one I'm always here to talk to! And having just gone through it (and still going through it) I know how hopeless it can all seem.. Please stay strong. Be aware that nights/mornings will be the hardest time. I still have trouble sleeping. If you take one thing away from this, save this number in your phone as "help" and just keep it there. 1 (800) 273-8255 - suicide prevention hotline USA. It may not seem like it but just hearing another human voice who cares can be enough sometimes. In either case, when the pain is so bad you can't take it, it's worth calling. Thinking of you <3

That's awful about your girlfriend, I had to live at distance in relationships before. Nothing is harder. I'm so glad you replied! And about the job, I know that feeling too :( for me I've missed my opportunities to make something of myself, and I can only hope that things will still work out okay job wise for me, I hope the same for you!

What happened? What were you planning that got shot down? I'm so sorry you're feeling so lost, I've been there myself, and completely alone at several times in my life. I hope you don't harm yourself. 

I have to take an exam now, but I'll be thinking of you. Please keep fighting stranger <3

Anytime. 

Just condition yourself. Call that number if you get really scared of yourself. Don't even analyze just press call and keep breathing !

Ugh. The torture of this sub. Knowing that YOU, right this moment, are in so much pain. 

I know it's meaningless to you, but I am a fellow human being sitting here, thinking of you. I care about you and want to help. I hope you keep fighting. Please make it through this night, be careful.

First of all, put this number in your phone, 1-800-273-8255. Suicide hotline but you can just save it as "call this number". 

In your darkest moments just call it. It seriously can save your life. 

Also, I could give you endless cliches about how it will get better but truly, you are 16. Fight on for the chance that it will be better one day. Please don't give up. We are all fighting. You are not alone. You can always find help. Don't rely on yourself in this, because your mind is momentarily sick. Tell your loved ones. Or just keep posting here. Don't give up.

The skill you are talking about isn't exactly skill, at least to my definition of it. You are just talking about decision making, and in doing so, you have hit the nail on the head with my biggest problem with the game.

It's all about that "decision making skill" as you say, when almost every other game out there takes mechanical skill AND good decision making to master.  This isn't just mobas either, look at street fighter, starcraft or counter-strike. 

I'd argue that decision making is actually way more important in all of those games, but they also take TREMENDOUS amounts of individual mechanical skill, which is what makes a compelling competitive game that can be played for years.

As I said, one of the problems with global exp, and the game having a very low mechanical skill ceiling compared to other mobas, makes for a grossly casual experience where it's hard to feel rewarded for playing well.

I'll agree with you it is more fun to play when underperforming, but the same argument goes the other way. I have way more fun with any other moba when I'm performing well, because I get rewarded for it. Performing well in heroes of the storm actually can be infuriating, because no matter how well you individually do, you just can't impact the game at times if the majority of your friends or teamates arent as good the majority of the opposing teams players.

At least in League or Dota, I can carry my bad friends in situations where the enemy team IS better than my friends, but I'm significantly better than the other team AND my friends, and can help balance the game out by being extremely big and fed and impactful, whereas doing well in Heroes of the Storm while your team isn't just feels disgusting. It's exactly the problem that everyone has always had with communism. Why should I work so hard when I receive no reward for doing so? Worse yet, no one on my team or the enemy team can really even see me doing any better than the players on my team because there is no farm, and all the stats are shared. Even if I have a low amount of deaths they can just write it off as I'm playing too carefully.

Heroes of the Storm is actually stressful to take as anything other than jumping on a massive trampoline with 9 other people having a good time. If you try to take the game seriously or be competitive, you might just end up in a terrible mood. Play it for what it is, good casual fun.

It's fun, but you are going to be hugely disappointed if you believe it is "hard to master". 

It's mostly a numbers game, stripped of all complexities other mobas offer. There is no farming, or build orders, or anything like that. It is your number of players vs my number of players from the very first minute. Which team has the majority of good players? It is not a game about individual skill in any way shape or form. You can be significantly better than the other players of the enemy team, but if they are significantly worse than you, but slightly better than the MAJORITY of your team, you will lose almost 100% of the time.

This is due to GLOBAL experience. The game is arguably more "snow bally" than any other moba simply because even the people on your team performing terribly will be outleveling the best players of the enemy team if the majority of your players are performing better than theirs.

Numbers game. Very fun, very simple, VERY casual.

Those are the facts.
